video_title: Kevin Love Was BARBECUE CHICKEN, Giannis in Miami & Clippers Are SCREWED

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo faces a major adjustment period in new system
quotes.excerpt: There is going to be a huge adjustment fitting into this system.
quotes.quote: There is going to be a huge adjustment fitting into this system. Yes, he can do this now because one, nobody's got to touch him, two, they're not scouting him, and three, he's going against bench guys. I think a big adjustment is going to be floor spacing. A big adjustment is always going to have a big man in the game for the most part. I think he's going to do great. I think he's always in MVP mode. Giannis doesn't have an adjustment button. He's like a car, you either turn it off or on.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The Los Angeles Clippers are in a difficult rebuilding position
quotes.excerpt: They're screwed. They're screwed for a long time.
quotes.quote: They're screwed. They're screwed for a long time. Just to rebuild, and then they're going to be behind even more. Look at the rebuild, look what it took Boston to finally get somewhere. Look what it took OKC, or San Antonio, or even Orlando, or Detroit. The Clippers, they are, they are very.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue's bench management during the 2016 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: Putting Dante Jones and Mo Williams in there in critical games and them being ready is beyond psychotic.
quotes.quote: Tyronn Lue's use of the bench in the NBA Finals. Putting Dante Jones and Mo Williams in there in critical games and them being ready is beyond psychotic. I don't know if Mo Williams had 30 minutes the whole playoffs, and you put him in Game 7? Stop it. Talk about trust.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA expansion should prioritize adding two teams over realigning divisions
quotes.excerpt: Do you think it's time for an NBA expansion? Absolutely. If so, how many teams? Two.
quotes.quote: Do you think it's time for an NBA expansion? Absolutely. If so, how many teams? Two. Either move Minnesota or I think Memphis to the East, and it will be perfectly fine. Vegas is done what they had to do. They wanted a baseball team, they do great with hockey, they do great with football, now you got basketball. Vegas is rebuilding and revamping to be more entertainment-based for tourism, which is more stability than gambling and entertainment-based.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's influence remains significant despite off-court controversies
quotes.excerpt: To say like Ja Morant's not going to put people in seats is crazy.
quotes.quote: The Grizzlies got rid of Ja Morant because they are moving to Nashville. The good old boys weren't going to give the people of Nashville a figure like Ja to look up to. Take? That's the stupidest thing I've ever heard. They're not going anywhere. Memphis is not going anywhere. And Ja Morant needed a change of scenery as much as the Grizzlies needed a change of guard. Ja Morant is a very good player. To say like Ja Morant's not going to put people in seats is crazy. I don't know if you know his influence on the youngsters up to date, but I'm pretty sure he has the highest selling shoe next to Kobe from Nike.
